$sources: The panel frame: a narrow flat fumed-oak moulding, 35 mm, round each of Morris's wallpaper panels (Docs/Stages/albion.md sec. 8, the wall works: 'in a narrow fumed-oak panel frame 0.035, glazed'; Data/Stages/albion/Finishes.json, albion.frame.oak). Its section is the museum's flat oak photograph frame's (Data/Art/Mouldings/photograph.json: its face 0.8 of its width above the glass, its arrises softened), the plain moulding a framer runs round a panel of paper, set out as the museum's moulding is: A outward from the edge of what it frames, B up from the face it rests on (the glazing's), in units of its width, drawn from the outside edge inward.
The width is the sheet's 35 mm whatever the panel's size, one moulding for the three.
The rebate stands 2 mm clear of the mount's edge all round, as the museum's moulding stands clear of a canvas's.

face.source: Data/Art/Mouldings/photograph.json: up the outside, round the outer arris, across the flat top, round the inner arris and down the sight edge to the glass.
